tags.label: Removal
tags.definition: Permanently answers one opposing permanent: destroy, exile, tuck, -X/-X, fight or bite, an aura that neuters it, or damage that can hit a creature (Lightning Bolt is Removal and Burn).
tags.exclude: Tapping, temporary effects, bouncing (that's Bounce), damage only to players.
tags.examples: Swords to Plowshares, Beast Within, Lightning Bolt

tags.label: Edict
tags.definition: Makes an opponent sacrifice a permanent of their choice.

tags.label: Board wipe
tags.definition: Hits every creature, or every permanent of a type, at once: destroy, exile, damage, -X/-X or mass bounce.

tags.label: Counterspell
tags.definition: Counters a spell or ability on the stack.

tags.label: Bounce
tags.definition: Returns an opposing permanent to its owner's hand.
tags.exclude: Returning your own cards for value (Blink, Recursion).

tags.label: Pinger
tags.definition: Deals 1-2 damage again and again, from a tap ability or a recurring trigger, to a creature or a player.

tags.label: Burn
tags.definition: Direct damage that can hit a player or planeswalker: any target, target player, each opponent.
tags.exclude: Damage only to creatures (Removal), combat damage.

tags.label: Steal
tags.definition: Gains control of an opponent's permanent or spell, even temporarily.

tags.label: Graveyard hate
tags.definition: Exiles graveyards or stops cards being cast or used from graveyards.
tags.exclude: Exiling your own graveyard as a cost.

tags.label: Tapper
tags.definition: Taps opposing creatures or keeps them from untapping.

tags.label: Stax / tax
tags.definition: Restricts or taxes opponents: cost increases, can't search, cast, untap or draw extra.

tags.label: Fog
tags.definition: Prevents combat damage for a turn.

tags.label: Ability removal
tags.definition: Makes a permanent lose its abilities, or stops activated or triggered abilities.

tags.label: Land destruction
tags.definition: Destroys, exiles or bounces lands opponents control, or keeps their lands tapped. Bracket-relevant.

tags.label: Mana generation
tags.definition: Adds mana beyond your land drop: rocks, dorks, rituals, mana doublers.

tags.label: Extra lands
tags.definition: Puts lands onto the battlefield from library or hand, or lets you play extra lands.

tags.label: Treasure tokens
tags.definition: Creates Treasure tokens for you.

tags.label: Cost reducer
tags.definition: Makes your spells or abilities cheaper.

tags.label: Card draw
tags.definition: You draw cards, including cantrips.

tags.label: Card selection
tags.definition: Filters your draws: scry, surveil, loot, rummage, cycling, landcycling, look at the top and rearrange.

tags.label: Tutor
tags.definition: Searches your library for a nonland card, to hand, top, graveyard or battlefield.

tags.label: Wheel
tags.definition: Each player, or you, discards or shuffles away a hand and draws a new one.

tags.label: Free to cast
tags.definition: This card can be cast without paying mana under a common condition: pitch costs, controlling your commander, life instead of mana.
tags.exclude: Casting other cards for free (Cheat into play).
tags.examples: Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Deflecting Swat

tags.label: Protection
tags.definition: Gives your other permanents or you hexproof, shroud, indestructible or protection, or makes your spells uncounterable.

tags.label: Phasing
tags.definition: Phases your permanents out on demand.
tags.exclude: The phasing keyword that phases on a schedule.
tags.examples: Slip Out the Back, Teferi's Protection

tags.label: Blink
tags.definition: Exiles and returns your own permanents to reuse enters effects or dodge removal.

tags.label: Regenerate
tags.definition: Regenerates creatures.

tags.label: Hard to kill
tags.definition: The card protects itself: indestructible, hexproof, ward, persist, undying, or returns when it dies.

tags.label: Pillow fort
tags.definition: Discourages or limits attacks against you.
tags.examples: Propaganda, Ghostly Prison, Maze of Ith

tags.label: Reanimation
tags.definition: Returns creatures or permanents from a graveyard to the battlefield.

tags.label: Recursion
tags.definition: Returns cards from your graveyard to your hand or library.

tags.label: Cheat into play
tags.definition: Puts permanents onto the battlefield without casting them, or casts other cards for free (cascade, discover).
tags.exclude: Land ramp; this card's own free cost (Free to cast).

tags.label: Tokens
tags.definition: Creates creature tokens for you.

tags.label: +1/+1 counters
tags.definition: Puts +1/+1 counters on your creatures or rewards having them.

tags.label: Proliferate
tags.definition: Proliferates.

tags.label: Sac outlet
tags.definition: Lets you sacrifice other permanents at will, cheaply and repeatably.

tags.label: Death trigger
tags.definition: Triggers or rewards you when creatures die.

tags.label: Lifegain
tags.definition: You gain life, including lifelink, or rewards life gain.

tags.label: Life drain
tags.definition: Opponents lose life (not damage).

tags.label: Mill
tags.definition: Puts cards from an opponent's library into their graveyard.

tags.label: Self-mill
tags.definition: Puts cards from your library into your graveyard to fuel graveyard plans.

tags.label: Discard
tags.definition: Makes opponents discard.

tags.label: Copy spells
tags.definition: Copies spells or abilities.

tags.label: Clone
tags.definition: Copies a permanent: enters as a copy, becomes a copy, or makes token copies.

tags.label: Landfall
tags.definition: Triggers when lands enter under your control.

tags.label: Spell payoff
tags.definition: Triggers when you cast or copy an instant, sorcery or noncreature spell, or has prowess.
tags.exclude: Triggers on opponents' spells or on casting the card itself.

tags.label: Graveyard cast
tags.definition: Lets you cast cards from a graveyard: flashback, escape, jump-start.

tags.label: Trigger doubler
tags.definition: Makes triggered abilities trigger an additional time, or copies triggers.

tags.label: Doubler
tags.definition: Doubles tokens, counters or mana you get.

tags.label: Damage amplifier
tags.definition: Increases or doubles damage your sources deal.

tags.label: Artifact payoff
tags.definition: Rewards casting artifacts or scales with artifacts you control.

tags.label: Enchantment payoff
tags.definition: Rewards casting enchantments or scales with enchantments you control.

tags.label: Poison / infect
tags.definition: Infect, toxic, poison counters, or proliferating poison.

tags.label: Commander payoff
tags.definition: Rules text refers to your commander or the command zone.

tags.label: Double power
tags.definition: Doubles a creature's power.

tags.label: Switch P/T
tags.definition: Switches power and toughness.

tags.label: Anthem
tags.definition: Boosts your creatures as a group, as a static ability or a one-shot "creatures you control get +N/+N".

tags.label: Pump
tags.definition: Temporary boost until end of turn.

tags.label: Stat boost
tags.definition: Makes one creature bigger for good: equipment and auras that add power, +1/+1 counters it puts on one creature, or a creature that gives itself +N/+N from a trigger or a condition.
tags.exclude: Team boosts (Anthem), until-end-of-turn pumps (Pump), paying mana to pump itself (Mana sink), power set by a count (Scaling body).

tags.label: Scaling body
tags.definition: Its power or toughness is set by a count ("equal to the number of"), or it gets +N/+N for each of something.
tags.exclude: Bodies that grow by counters or pump abilities.

tags.label: Extra combat
tags.definition: Gives additional combat phases.

tags.label: Untap
tags.definition: Untaps your permanents.

tags.label: Lure
tags.definition: Forces creatures to block it.

tags.label: Animate
tags.definition: Turns noncreature permanents into creatures.

tags.label: Mana sink
tags.definition: A repeatable ability that pays mana to pump or animate this card itself (firebreathing, "{1}: +1/+0", a manland's own animation).
tags.exclude: Abilities that pay mana for anything else: counters on it, drawing, tokens, removal.

tags.label: Evasion
tags.definition: Flying, menace, trample, shadow, landwalk or can't be blocked, for itself or others.

tags.label: Deathtouch
tags.definition: Has or grants deathtouch.

tags.label: First strike
tags.definition: Has or grants first strike or double strike.

tags.label: Haste
tags.definition: Has or grants haste.

tags.label: Flash
tags.definition: Has flash, or lets you cast spells at instant speed.

tags.label: Defender
tags.definition: Has defender.

tags.label: Combat keyword
tags.definition: Has or grants a combat keyword not covered elsewhere: vigilance, reach, lifelink-style keywords, exalted, mentor, ninjutsu, dash, blitz, myriad, rampage, bushido, "can block additional creatures".
tags.exclude: Flying, trample, menace (Evasion); first strike, deathtouch, haste have their own tags.

tags.label: Vanilla
tags.definition: A creature with no rules text beyond plain combat keywords and cost keywords (kicker, morph, echo).
tags.exclude: Any creature with a real ability, including shroud, hexproof or a drawback.

tags.label: Extra turn
tags.definition: Takes extra turns.

tags.label: Goad
tags.definition: Forces opponents' creatures to attack.

tags.label: Monarch
tags.definition: Makes you the monarch or takes the initiative.

tags.label: Vote
tags.definition: Uses voting.

tags.label: Group hug
tags.definition: Gives every player resources: cards, mana, lands or life.
tags.exclude: Symmetric effects that mainly hurt (Affects you too).

tags.label: Kindred
tags.definition: Names or rewards a creature type: lords, type-matters triggers, tutoring or counting a type.

tags.label: Fixing land
tags.definition: A land that makes or finds two or more colors.

tags.label: Utility land
tags.definition: A land with a nonmana ability worth a slot.

tags.label: Basic land
tags.definition: Basic land.

tags.label: Mana land
tags.definition: A land whose only job is tapping for one color or colorless: no second color, no other ability.
tags.exclude: Lands that make two or more colors (Fixing land) or do anything else (Utility land).

tags.label: Enters trigger
tags.definition: Has a trigger when it, or another creature, enters the battlefield.

tags.label: Attack trigger
tags.definition: Does something when it attacks, is blocked, or deals combat damage to a player.

tags.label: Aura
tags.definition: Aura (card type only; never a card's main tag).

tags.label: Equipment
tags.definition: Equipment (card type only).

tags.label: Vehicle
tags.definition: Vehicle (card type only).

tags.label: Saga / class
tags.definition: Saga, Class, Case or Room (card type only).

tags.label: Planeswalker
tags.definition: Planeswalker (card type only).

tags.label: Costs life
tags.definition: You pay or lose life: life in a cost, Phyrexian mana, 'you lose life', damage from your own land or rock.

tags.label: You discard
tags.definition: You discard cards: discard as a cost or an effect on you.

tags.label: Sacrifice cost
tags.definition: You sacrifice a creature, land or nontoken permanent you'd want to keep.
tags.exclude: Sacrificing Treasures, Clues or the card itself.

tags.label: Exiles your cards
tags.definition: Exiles cards from your hand or graveyard to pay.

tags.label: Helps an opponent
tags.definition: The opponent gets a token, Treasures, cards, life or a land.

tags.label: Upkeep cost
tags.definition: Ongoing payment to keep it: cumulative upkeep, echo, fading, vanishing, 'pay or sacrifice', pacts.

tags.label: Enters tapped
tags.definition: Always enters tapped.
tags.exclude: Checklands, fastlands and other conditional lands.

tags.label: Affects you too
tags.definition: The effect hits you as well: each player draws, discards or sacrifices.

tags.label: Combat drawback
tags.definition: Restrictions on its own combat: can't block, attacks each combat, doesn't untap.
